quote: So Iconic! I love this game. Playing again on NS. Excelent story and music. I want a second episode.

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: I'm truly impressed! Fantastic world design and story! So unique. The music is a masterpiece. I will order also the NSW2 version. Thanolk you Capcom

quote: Great game from Nintendo. Thank you to Bri g ths to NS2. Such iconic music and experience. I think this justify purchase SW2. Looking forward to Majora's Mask.

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: The GOAT! This is is the best game ever produced. And the Music and the concept are outstanding! Worth buying aN64 only for THE ZELDA
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: Truly a disappointment! How is it possible to write such a substandard story where the main character is so bad, bad, bad? Forget the graphics, forget the glitches, forget the lack of a physical game, forget the 30 fps… This is an ugly game story. It is not GTA… It is a relationship sim. Extremely bad, despite the sponsored press and their fanboys gaslighting the fan community. This is a STAR WARS scenario. Shame on ROCKSTAR!

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: Playing the AC Ezio trilogy on a 15-hour flight is my dream! Thank you, Nintendo Switch, for this perfect port. I love Ezio; it's the best AC trilogy.

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: Best of the best on PS. A beautiful experience. A must play. The story, the dialogue, and the ambience are truly magical. Graphic with recent patch and update is very good. Best AC by far! My GOAT.

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: Terrible! The dialogue is boring, and the quests are very repetitive. I have been a day-one fan of the Assassin's Creed saga, but the developers really messed up. The portrayal of ancient Japanese culture is very disrespectful. I will sell the game. Waste of time and money. Ubisoft not delivering.

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: Masterpiece!  Incredible remaster that bring so much more from Wii original game. Technically outstanding on a switch. Reference for the switch. My first GOTY nominee of 2025.Cannot wait to play it on Switch2. Thank you Monolith games.

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: Enotria infuses a lively  , vibrang Italian and Mediterranean energy and flair into the challenging soul games, providing a refreshing alternative to what FromSoftware established with the Souls series. I appreciate very much  the music, the demanding combat, and the stunning sunny open world, all of which contribute to making this a remarkable game. I am eagerly anticipating the physical edition. This game is special!

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: This game hit me like a bomb. I feel I am Goku. This is a must for fans and new players of the Dragon Ball world! It's a majestic game with great music, graphics, and visuals. I’m in love with Sparking Zero.

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: This is definitely a good game. Fantastic visual and story. It features enjoyable challenges and definitely intriguing storytelling. I love the world of Raji and the Indusn gods Devas...great music and the world-building elements that make an immersive story. Listening to the narrations by the goddess Durga about the wars between the Devas (gods) and Asuras (demons) is captivating and enchanting. I wish there were more games that explored stories from Indian mythology. This game is truly a gem!

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: Masterpiece! I can't add anything more. I’m just grateful to Atlus for this immersive new world, especially after giving us Persona and Shin Megami Tensei. They are one of the top developer studios right now! Thank you, Atlus; keep going! Metaphor features wonderful gameplay, story, music, dialogue, and graphics. The music is particularly beautiful, along with the world-building and character design. It might be one of my Game of the Year contenders for 2024! A game fogamersand JPRG lovers.

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: I absolutely love it! Rise of Ronin truly immerses you in the world of samurai. The Team Ninja  never disappoints. While the graphics aren't the best we've seen on the PS5, the gameplay and story are very satisfying to me. I'm extremely happy with it. Although it doesn't earn for me a 10 like Ghost of Tsushima or Nioh Collection , it is an excellent game that respects historical accuracy. A Samurai game gem! If you enjoy samurai or Asian historical games, this is a must-have for your collection. Good Job Team Ninja Studio.

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: The dialogues and story in this game are terrible. What happened? Who wrote this? It's hard to believe that a studio like EA BioWare could ruin the Dragon Age franchise like this. After a 10-year wait, BioWare has completely messed up the Dragon Age IP. We urge you to listen to gamers; we are truly disappointed. This has been a disaster. I am requesting a refund and will go back to playing the original Dragon Age and Dragon Age: Inquisition. Please stop pushing a woke agenda in games. It's important to hire teams based on merit rather than focusing Woke agenda and on diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). Hiregood people with experience that knows how to write a dark fantasy game!

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: I love this trilogy; it's a very beautiful experience. However, I hope the remake doesn't change the cut scenes, particularly the appearance of Miranda. I look forward to Bioware listening to gamers and fans to preserve the original game without making updates based on their own judgments or current agendas. In short, please no "woke" changes in the remastered games! And Bioware please don't screw up new Mass Effect like you did on Dragon Age Veil Guard…please listen to gamersor the studio will fail!

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: What a fantastic game! It may have the best graphics and sci-fi immersion I have seen on my PS5. Truly exceptional. I cannot get enough of this game. For me, it was worth the purchase of the PS5. My GOTY 2024!   I love this Korean studio. Looking forward the next game.

author: Simone_BJJ
quote: I had a fantastic experience with this game. I'm really grateful for the total immersion in Chinese and Eastern mythology! The gameplay, graphics, and storytelling are outstanding. The bosses are the best I have ever seen. I’m eagerly awaiting the physical edition to add this true gem to my collection. This game is truly a benchmark for this generation.
